completion.releaseNote: Share a project outside git through a synced folder: `sati init --share` or `sati sync share`.
completion.summary: ADR 0009 and code (commit bcd34e3). A standalone project with "share": true in .sati/sati.config.json keeps its records as files in .sati/; the database stays in ~/.sati/projects. `sati init --share` starts one, `sati sync share` turns it on, `sati init` in the synced folder joins and imports. Each command, the board and the MCP server load record files whose size or modified time changed (list in <db>.folder.json). A conflicted copy of a record is merged by stamps and deleted. Verified: new CLI test with two home folders; lint, typecheck, full test pass. Not verified: a real Dropbox/OneDrive/iCloud folder. Limits in the ADR: claims can collide inside the sync window, locks not shared, one unreadable file holds back that load.

title: Folder-sync mode: share a project through a synced folder without git (ADR first)
